alerts.title: Iran war live: Trump hints at possible Sunday Iran attack or deal reached
alerts.why: Threat of US military action against Iran introduces immediate geopolitical risk premium and potential supply disruption concerns for crude.

itemsSent.title: Peak Hormuz
itemsSent.why: Strait of Hormuz shuttle bottlenecks restrict physical crude flow, creating a bullish supply friction constraint for WTI.

itemsSent.title: Fuel Oil Becomes Asia’s Next Cost Shock
itemsSent.why: Singapore bunker fuel costs surge above crude due to Middle East and Russian supply disruptions, boosting regional refined product prices.

itemsSent.title: Houthis launch attacks on Saudi Arabia and Yemen’s Aden
itemsSent.why: Geopolitical tensions remain elevated in the region, but previous Houthi strikes have had limited sustained impact on actual physical oil supply.

itemsSent.title: Record Tanker Rates Cripple U.S. Crude Oil Flows to Asia
itemsSent.why: Record tanker rates cripple US crude exports to Asia, trapping crude domestically (bearish WTI) while tightening destination markets (bullish products).
